scope: art UI review fixtures; not game balance or persistence

fixtures.placementBadges: dedicated growth fixtures, not a live formation model

rules.lineageLevel: one shared level for guardian and echo
rules.shopMax: enabled when two or more levels affordable
rules.resonance: confirm before spending; guard against duplicate confirms
rules.P1: limit break and extra concurrent echo are not shown

pointerOwnership.scope: Browser review growth holds, not Unity touch handling.
pointerOwnership.owner: First primary pointer owns one hold across growth purchase buttons. Additional pointer downs do not create timers.
pointerOwnership.events: Only the owning pointer can move/cancel/release its hold. Timer callbacks check the same gesture and attached button.
pointerOwnership.otherActions: Keyboard batch/max/resonance clicks are ignored while a pointer hold is active; navigation may cancel the hold.
pointerOwnership.release: Stop and clear both timeout and interval, release pointer capture, keep completed purchases.
pointerOwnership.freshInput: A new touch or keyboard activation works normally after release/cancel.
pointerOwnership.test: verify-pointer.cjs: Chromium CDP multi-touch + native mouse/keyboard; physical devices and Unity are unverified.

sheetFocus.scope: Browser nonmodal growth region; bottom navigation and battle alert remain available.
sheetFocus.entry: Explicit growth navigation, review toolbar and failure-strengthen entry focus the sheet close button.
sheetFocus.return: Close click/keyboard/Escape returns to the review toolbar trigger or growth navigation. Removed failure triggers fall back to growth navigation.
sheetFocus.redraw: Ratio/fixture redraw does not take focus from outer review controls.
sheetFocus.nested: Detail back and resonance cancellation keep their existing local focus return.
sheetFocus.test: verify-sheet-focus.cjs; native Chromium keyboard, two reference ratios; not Unity/device certification.
